Which statement about bonding is correct?
A
All the atoms in CH4, NH3 and H2O molecules have noble gas electronic configurations.
B
Calcium chloride is a covalent molecule.
C
Group I metals gain electrons when they bond with Group VII elements.
D
Oxide ions in calcium oxide are positively charged.
